name: OpenCorporates
summary: An open database of companies from official registers worldwide: legal entities with officers, filings, control (beneficial ownership) statements and gazette notices.

api_token.description: An OpenCorporates API token (opencorporates.com > API account). Sent as the api_token query parameter.

notes: A key is required on every call; daily and monthly call quotas depend on the plan. Daily usage resets at midnight UTC; check it with opencorporates.account.status.
Lists page with page and per_page: 30 per page by default, up to 100, and page stops at 100.
Date filters take one date or a range start:end with either end open (2020-01-01: or :2020-12-31). Term filters take one term, a comma list (match all) or a pipe list (match any).
Data is under the Open Database Licence (share-alike, attribution): link each company's opencorporates_url when you show it. A company temporarily redacted answers 503.

endpoints.name: Search companies
endpoints.summary: Companies whose current or previous name holds every word searched, filtered by jurisdiction, status, type, industry code, address and dates.

q.description: Name words, any order; end with * for a prefix match (Barclays Bank*).

jurisdiction_code.description: Jurisdiction code(s), term filter, e.g. gb or us_de.

country_code.description: Country code(s): covers every jurisdiction in a multi-jurisdiction country such as the US.

company_type.description: Company type as the register names it.

current_status.description: Status as the register names it, e.g. Active.

industry_codes.description: Industry code uids, code scheme and code joined by a hyphen, e.g. eu_nace_2-869.

registered_address.description: Address words to match, e.g. 52 London.

created_at.description: Date or range the company was added to OpenCorporates.

updated_at.description: Date or range the company record last changed.

inactive.description: true for inactive companies only, false to exclude them.

branch.description: true for branches only, false to exclude them.

nonprofit.description: true for nonprofit types only, false to exclude them.

identifier_uids.description: Third-party identifiers (business, charity or tax numbers) to match.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to search: name, normalised_name, company_number, heavily_normalised_number, native_company_number, previous_names, postal_codes, trademark_registration_mark_texts.

normalise_company_name.description: true to normalise q first (Ltd to Limited, Corp to Corporation).

order.description: Ordering: alphabetical by default; score, or newest first by created_at, updated_at, incorporation_date or dissolution_date.

notes: Unlike the website, the API does not normalise names unless normalise_company_name=true.

endpoints.name: Get a company
endpoints.summary: Core register data for one company: name, number, type, status, incorporation and dissolution dates, registered address, industry codes, previous names, officers, recent filings and data held.

jurisdiction_code.description: Jurisdiction code: a two-letter ISO country code (gb, es) or an underscored subdivision code (us_de, us_mi).

company_number.description: The company number given by the register.

sparse.description: true to leave out filings and other data: faster and smaller.

notes: inactive=true is OpenCorporates' mapping of dissolved, removed or liquidated statuses; a missing flag does not mean the company is active.

endpoints.name: List a company's filings
endpoints.summary: Statutory filings for one company, with date, title, type and a link to the document where the register offers it.

jurisdiction_code.description: Jurisdiction code: a two-letter ISO country code (gb, es) or an underscored subdivision code (us_de, us_mi).

company_number.description: The company number given by the register.

endpoints.name: List a company's statements
endpoints.summary: Statements of fact about one company from public records or users: subsidiaries, shareholdings, licences, branch relationships, with provenance.

jurisdiction_code.description: Jurisdiction code: a two-letter ISO country code (gb, es) or an underscored subdivision code (us_de, us_mi).

company_number.description: The company number given by the register.

endpoints.name: Search officers
endpoints.summary: Directors, officers and agents whose name holds every word searched, with their company and position.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth or range (held for UK directors only).

inactive.description: true for inactive officers only, false to exclude them.

order.description: score for relevance; alphabetical by default.

endpoints.name: Get an officer
endpoints.summary: One officer: name, position, company, start and end dates, address and date of birth where known.

endpoints.name: Search control statements
endpoints.summary: Beneficial ownership and control statements: who controls an entity, by what mechanism, and whether they are ultimate beneficial owners.

is_ultimate_beneficial_owner.description: true for statements naming ultimate beneficial owners.

has_controlling_entities.description: true for statements that name any controlling entity.

control_mechanisms_mechanism_type.description: Control types, e.g. share ownership or voting rights.

controlling_entities_entity_type.description: Controlling entity types, e.g. company or person.

created_at.description: Date or range the statement was added.

order.description: score for relevance; newest first by default.

endpoints.name: Search gazette notices
endpoints.summary: Official gazette notices (insolvencies, dissolutions and other legal notices) matching every word searched.

publication_title.description: The publication the notice appeared in.

order.description: score for relevance; newest published first by default.

endpoints.name: Match a jurisdiction name
endpoints.summary: The jurisdiction code for a country or state written in any common form (GB, United Kingdom, Delaware (USA)).

q.description: Jurisdiction name or code as written.

related_jurisdiction_code.description: A hint to disambiguate, e.g. us for Georgia the state.

endpoints.name: Get account usage
endpoints.summary: Plan, expiry, and calls used and remaining today and this month.
